result.rationale: CAND::1 explicitly recomputes β^Tβ for the single-row case, showing it is rank-1 with eigenvalues (|v|²,0,0), contradicting the paper's claimed eigenvalues (β_ix²,β_iy²,β_iz²) and revealing that both cases actually share the same eigenvalue structure.
Both identify that the claimed asymmetric eigenvalues of β^Tβ for left vs right identity cases are actually identical, invalidating the main argument about distinguishing the two cases.
